title: Bar binary layout descriptor
description: Describes a `<tf>.bin` candle artifact. The layout itself is fixed by this schema's constants; a descriptor instance carries the per-file values a reader needs to validate a file before mapping it. Layout: little-endian; 16-byte header = magic u32 (0x31425442, ASCII 'BTB1'), version u32 (1), count u32, colCount u32; then colCount contiguous Float64 columns in the order t,o,h,l,c,v; column i starts at byte 16 + i*count*8; no padding; total size 16 + colCount*count*8. t is epoch milliseconds stored as a Float64 (exact below 2^53). Missing volume is 0. The file sha256 lives in the snapshot manifest, not in the file.

layoutVersion.description: The version field inside the file header.

colCount.description: 5 when the writer had no volume column; readers then treat v as 0.
